correctness.rationale: The radius-growth Boolean identity and two homogeneous fixed states give an exact disjoint basin decomposition for every p>=1 and N>=3, including wrapped cases. Run-length closed walks give the exact matrix trace. Perron–Frobenius and the positive-root identity prove the unique z=m crossing; differentiation and a uniform primitive spectral gap prove both the critical density and the finite-size logistic limit. The embedded standalone program passed 8,488 exact finite assertions; they do not replace proof.
